cohort: Women who underwent induction of labor after one cesarean (IOLAC) at a university hospital in Malaysia between January 2018 and September 2022.
finding: Obesity, short stature, no prior vaginal delivery, previous cesarean indicated by failure to progress, unfavorable Bishop score, and ethnicity were independent predictors for unplanned cesarean after IOLAC.
mod_finding: No prior vaginal delivery was an independent predictor for unplanned cesarean after induction of labor after one cesarean.
